source.test: importModpack(from:for:) ditto extraction + mergeDirectory, symlink handling

expected.reason: `ditto -x -k` (line 429-434) extracts whatever entry types the archive contains with its own default (Mac-metadata-preserving) behavior; `mergeDirectory` (line 840-865) only checks `.isDirectoryKey` on each extracted item (line 846) to decide recurse-vs-copy -- it never checks `.isSymbolicLinkKey` or resolves/rejects a symlink before copying through it. A malicious override entry that IS a symlink pointing outside the temp extraction root would be followed by `copyItem` without any check stopping it.

notes: P8.14's own working-exit-criterion language ('reject hostile archive paths/symlinks') and the Rust ZIP requirement (never ditto) both already commit to closing this; recorded here as the concrete mechanism-level confirmation of why, not a new decision.
